clips.title: The story
paras: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear seeks samples of volatile incendicite ore from the Wetlands. He believes its explosive force could change dwarven artillery, and needs miners to reach a secluded cave and bring back the dangerous mineral.

Incendicite, a rare and unstable mineral, has drawn the attention of siege engine pilots and mechanics at Steelgrill's Depot. Rich veins are rumored to lie in a cavern northwest of Algaz Gate, in the Wetlands. The ore is highly reactive and dangerous to handle. Careless miners have found it detonating in their faces.

Pilot Stonegear sees military promise in the dangerous ore. Refined correctly, incendicite could power dwarven artillery or serve as its payload, giving cannon shells force enough to break fortified defenses. Stonegear wants raw samples so researchers can test ways to smelt it without blowing up the depot.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I heard that a rare ore, incendicite, was found in the Wetlands, in a cave northwest of Algaz Gate. Incendicite is volatile stuff and hard to use without blowing yourself up, but I'm sure if it's smelted the right way it could make cannon shells that pack a mighty punch!
Get me incendicite ore and I'll find someone brave enough to experiment with it.
Oh, and to extract that ore from a vein you'll need skill in mining. If you don't have it, then... Bring a friend who does to that cave!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got the ore! Well done, friend! I'll get someone to work with this right away. Let's hope he doesn't blow himself up!
